summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 19,500,000 ordinary shares on May 1, 2026, as part of an existing share buyback program announced on January 30, 2026. Shares were bought via Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 98.3630 pence per share. The company intends to cancel the purchased shares. This is a routine open-market repurchase under an ongoing program, not a tender offer or special capital return event. No special-situation catalyst or unusual terms are present.
